quotes.text: My husband, myself, my Dad, Stepmom, Aunt and Uncle booked a six person offshore fishing trip for the opening day of Red Snapper and Grouper season. I was a little apprehensive going in to this trip because I had never been out that far on a boat and wasn't sure what to expect. Capitan Shawn made this day one of the great memories I know I will never forget. I know we were a handful but he made us all feel comfortable and we also limited out on Red Snappers! I would recommend him to anyone both inexperienced and experienced that want to go out and have a fun and productive fishing trip.

Had an amazing day of scalloping and fishing with Captain Shawn! He took our group of four to a few different spots to scallop. We all had a great time scalloping and then we spent the second part of the day fishing. We caught Spanish mackerel, trout, mangrove snapper and more! Awesome day on the water! Captain Shawn took us to all the great spots and was very knowledgeable. Would highly recommend using this company. We will be booking again!

My wife and I came down for a day fish, we misjudged the weather and didn’t bring the right clothing. It was windy and cold with light showers. Shawn gave us some extra clothes to wear to keep us warm and dry.On top of that, we caught plenty of fish. It was a good day.Shawn’s a down-to-earth guy. He’s knowledgeable, but humble. And always down to joke around and BS. You learn a lot and laugh often.We will return

We had a great day on the water with Captain Shawn! He clearly knows his stuff, and we learned a lot with him. My husband and I both enjoyed our time with him, as did our two teenaged children. We also caught plenty of Spanish mackerel and speckled trout for dinner! We will definitely book another charter with Shawn next time we're in Crystal River.

Shawn is a great guide who knows what he’s talking about. If you are looking for a great duck hunt, Shawn is your guy. He had everything set up for us and clearly put in the work before hand. He also has a phenomenal dog named Rebel, who is clearly trained and a great hunting dog. Loved this experience and will 100% be back again.

Captain Shawn took us out for the best day of fishing on his in shore boat and we had a blast. He was fun, funny and very polite, but also knows exactly what he's doing. Listen to him and you will get lots of fish. We brought in Reds, Trout, Spanish Mackeral and a Sea bass. Definitely recommend him and his outfit. We will be back.
